messages:
Alex: Heads up — I'm at the airport and my flight got delayed. I'm primary for tonight's 00:00-08:00 window but just got paged for an embeddings latency surge. Need someone to flip primary ASAP or shadow while I board. Pager link: https://pd.example.com/inc/ABC123

PagerDuty: ALERT: Embedding cluster latency > 300ms (p95). Triggered 2 minutes ago. Paging @primary-oncall

Priya: I can take primary for the next 2 hours if needed. Where's the runbook for a quick swap? Any safe fallback model to route to?

OpsBot: Runbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall/primary-swap — quick steps: 1) update rotation-bot, 2) transfer pager in PD, 3) update incident channel. snippet: ```rotation-bot assign --primary sam --secondary jin```

Sam: I can take it. I'll do a soft handover: monitor p95, hold off on restarts unless errors > 5% and call for a prod freeze.

Alex: Thanks Sam — copying runbook excerpt: ```if swap_needed:
  notify_secondary()
  update_rotation_calendar()
  post_handoff_checks()``` I'm still on ground but ~20m to gate. I'll hand off pager in PD now.

PagerDuty: INFO: Pager transferred to Sam (sam@redwood)

Jin: I'll shadow Sam for the next hour. What's the immediate mitigation? Autoscale isn't kicking fast enough?

Sam: Short term mitigations: enable burst pool (Console > Dedicated > Burst = ON), increase batching window from 10ms -> 25ms for embedding workers, and trigger KV-cache warmup. Commands: ```rdwctl scale burst enable --pool embeddings-burst``` and ```rdwctl kvcache warmup --model open-embed-1 --workers 4```

Priya: Can someone post the customer impact note? Legal asked for a T+30 update. We should note any errors and which customers might see degraded latency.

Alex: Impact: elevated latency to embeddings for ~3% of requests (mainly large-batch async clients). No data loss. Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings and /v1/batch-embed. I'll draft a short blurb.

Alex: Blurb: 'We're investigating increased embeddings latency; we've shifted traffic to burst capacity and are monitoring. No requests failed; we will provide an update within 30 minutes.'

OpsBot: Rotation-bot updated: primary=Sam, secondary=Jin, note='flight delay swap'

Sam: :thumbsup: taking primary. Confirmed PD transfer and rotation-bot update. I'll post a 15m status in 15.

Priya: Thanks all. @Alex safe travels. @Sam please ping if any escalation — I'll stand by for T+30.

PagerDuty: RESOLVED: alert ABC123 resolved (p95 back to normal). Time open ~12 minutes.

Sam: Closing loop: p95 back to normal, scaled memory on 2 embedding workers, KV cache warmup seemed to help. Keeping primary until 02:00 unless Alex confirms return. Marking handoff done.
